name: Nuoc mam nhi Cua Dai
summary: Nước mắm nhỉ Cửa Đại is a fish sauce the September 2023 fair lists among recognized products, spelled nhỉ. An earlier account spells it nhĩ and lists it as a 2022 target.
origin: Duy Xuyên. The 2022 account lists it as a target, and the September 2023 fair lists it among recognized products.
where: The Fatherland Front’s OCOP account spells it nhĩ and lists it as a 2022 target.
The fair of 22–24 Sep 2023 spells it nhỉ and includes it among recognized OCOP products.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam nhi Cua Dai — fish sauce, two spellings
seoDescription: The September 2023 fair lists nước mắm nhỉ Cửa Đại among recognized products. An earlier account spells it nhĩ and lists it as a 2022 target.
